JINGLE.gloss: make a sound typical of metallic objects
JINGLE.definition: Make a sound typical of metallic objects.
JINGLE.example: The keys were jingling in his pocket.

LIGNE.gloss: a linear unit used to measure diameter of buttons
LIGNE.definition: A linear unit (1/40 inch) used to measure diameter of buttons.

LINE.gloss: a formation of people or things one beside another
LINE.definition: A formation of people or things one beside another.
LINE.example: The line of soldiers advanced with their bayonets fixed.

LING.gloss: water chestnut whose spiny fruit has two rather than 4 prongs
LING.definition: Water chestnut whose spiny fruit has two rather than 4 prongs.

LIE.definition: Be located or situated somewhere; occupy a certain position.

LEG.definition: A human limb; commonly used to refer to a whole limb but technically only the part of the limb between the knee and ankle.

GEN.example: Give me the gen on your new line of computers.

GLEN.definition: A narrow secluded valley (in the mountains).

GEL.gloss: a colloid in a more solid form than a sol
GEL.definition: A colloid in a more solid form than a sol.

GIN.gloss: strong liquor flavored with juniper berries
GIN.definition: Strong liquor flavored with juniper berries.

LIEN.gloss: the right to take another's property if an obligation is not discharged
LIEN.definition: The right to take another's property if an obligation is not discharged.
